About Vic's Tile

Who We Are & What We Do

Vic's Tile is a licensed tile and remodeling contractor based in Livermore, California, serving homeowners throughout the Bay Area. Owner and operator Victor holds California Contractor License #857849 and brings hands-on craftsmanship to every project — from single bathroom tile repairs to full whole-home flooring installations.

We specialize in bathroom remodels, shower remodels, custom tile showers, kitchen backsplash installation, floor tile installation, fireplace tile surrounds, luxury vinyl plank flooring, and custom mosaic tile work. Every project is completed by Victor personally — not subcontracted — which means consistent quality and direct accountability on every job.

Vic's Tile serves the entire Bay Area including Livermore, Pleasanton, Dublin, Danville, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, Concord, Lafayette, Alamo, Oakland, Berkeley, Hayward, San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, San Francisco, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Redwood City, Tracy, Manteca, Mountain House, and surrounding communities.

We offer free estimates with no obligation. Most projects begin within 2–4 weeks of estimate approval. References and photos of completed work are available upon request.

FAQ

Common Questions Answered

How much does a bathroom remodel cost in the Bay Area? +

A basic bathroom tile refresh (floor and shower surround) typically runs $2,500–$5,000. A mid-range bathroom remodel with new tile throughout, including shower, floor, and backsplash, generally costs $5,000–$12,000. A full luxury bathroom remodel with custom tile, heated floors, and premium materials can range from $12,000–$25,000+. Prices vary based on square footage, tile selection, and project complexity. We provide free detailed estimates so you know exactly what to expect before any work begins.

How much does a shower remodel cost? +

A standard shower tile replacement (re-tiling an existing shower) typically runs $1,500–$4,000 depending on size and tile choice. A full custom shower remodel — including waterproofing membrane, new tile, niche, bench, and frameless glass — generally costs $4,000–$10,000+. Walk-in shower conversions and frameless glass installations are priced separately. Contact us for a free estimate specific to your project.

How much does tile installation cost per square foot? +

Labor for tile installation in the Bay Area typically runs $8–$18 per square foot depending on tile size, pattern complexity, and substrate preparation required. Large-format tiles, herringbone patterns, and intricate mosaics are on the higher end. This does not include the cost of tile materials, which varies widely based on your selections. We can provide a complete all-in estimate including materials and labor.

Is Vic's Tile licensed and insured? +

Yes. Vic's Tile holds California Contractor License #857849. We are fully licensed to perform tile, flooring, and remodeling work throughout the state of California. We recommend always verifying a contractor's license before hiring — you can verify ours at the California Contractors State License Board (CSLB) website at cslb.ca.gov.

What areas do you serve? +

We serve the entire Bay Area from our base in Livermore, CA. This includes Pleasanton, Dublin, Danville, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, Concord, Lafayette, Alamo, Oakland, Berkeley, Hayward, San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, San Francisco, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Redwood City, San Mateo, Tracy, Manteca, Mountain House, and surrounding communities. Not sure if we cover your area? Give us a call or send a message — we're happy to let you know.

How long does a bathroom remodel take? +

A standard bathroom tile remodel typically takes 3–7 days depending on the scope of work. A full bathroom gut-and-remodel including waterproofing, backer board, tile installation, and grouting generally takes 5–10 business days. Tile requires a curing period before the shower can be used — typically 24–72 hours after grouting. We'll give you a clear timeline during your estimate so you can plan accordingly.

Do you offer heated floor installation? +

Yes. We install the Schluter Ditra Heat radiant floor heating system as part of our tile installations. This electric in-floor heating system is ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, and any tiled area. We recently completed a 1,200+ square foot whole-home floor tile installation with the Ditra Heat system throughout. Adding radiant heat during a tile installation is significantly more cost-effective than retrofitting later — ask us about including it in your project.

How do I get a free estimate? +

Simply fill out the contact form on this page, use our chat widget, or call Victor directly at (925) 699-8549. We'll schedule a time to visit your home, assess the project, and provide a detailed written estimate at no charge. Most estimates are completed within 2–3 business days of your request.
